# Rilla Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ingleside, Glen St. Mary, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v5 c4 P0](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Rilla is a fat, roly-poly little girl with a rosy face and curly red hair. She has hazel eyes that wrinkle up in a funny fashion when she goes to sleep. She lisps when she speaks.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Rilla is a proud, vain little girl who takes great delight in fine clothes, such as her best lace hat, blue sash, and beaded slippers. Though easily frightened, she can be stubborn when trying to carry out an errand. She is also inclined to strut when she feels well-dressed.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)_

## Traits

- Vain about her clothes  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000)</sub>
- Timid  <sub>[v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)</sub>
- Stubborn  <sub>[v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007)</sub>

## History

Rilla Blythe grew up as the youngest child of the Blythe family at Ingleside. On one occasion, she was entrusted by Susan Baker to deliver a basket of early strawberries to Mr. Meredith or Aunt Martha at the manse. Dressed in her best clothes, she strutted through the village street, where she encountered Mary Vance. Mary attempted to take the basket from her, but Rilla firmly refused to surrender it. In retaliation, Mary threatened her with a large dried codfish, causing Rilla to flee in terror. During the chase, Rilla tripped and fell into a mud-puddle at the end of the street, ruining her fine clothes and hat, before being rescued by Miss Cornelia.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c4 P0](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0000), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)_
